children: Parade Technologies, Ltd. (Taipei Exchange: 4966.TWO), a leading high-speed interface IC supplier, today announced financial results for the third quarter fiscal year 2026 ended September 30, 2026, and provided guidance for the fourth quarter of fiscal year 2026.

Consolidated revenue was US$130.83 million and consolidated net income was US$18.49 million. Basic and fully diluted after-tax earnings per share (“EPS”) were US$0.24 (NT$7.69) and US$0.24 (NT$7.67), respectively. These results compared to consolidated revenue US$146.14 million and consolidated net income of US$27.24 million, or US$0.35 (NT$10.45) and US$0.35 (NT$10.43) per basic and fully diluted share, in the year-ago quarter.
In US dollars, the third quarter of 2026 consolidated revenue decreased 2.71% sequentially and was down 10.48% year-over-year.
The gross profit in the third quarter of 2026 was US$52.71 million, representing a decrease of 2.50% from the previous quarter and a decrease of 15.14% compared to the same quarter of last year.

On September 1, 2026, Parade announced its PS9010 USB-IF certified USB4® dock controller has been integrated into the Acer ProDesigner PE320QX, a professional-grade monitor for creators. Designed to meet the rising demand for high-speed and multi-protocol connectivity in creative workflows, the PS9010 enables the Acer ProDesigner PE320QX to serve as both an ultra-high-resolution display and a high-performance, single-cable USB4® docking hub. The Acer ProDesigner PE320QX is built to optimize the user experience in workflows where high-bandwidth data transfers and multi-display connections are critical. By integrating the PS9010, the monitor seamlessly supports USB4®, DisplayPort™ 2.1, and SuperSpeed USB, ensuring robust compatibility with a wide range of host systems and peripherals. With dedicated USB4® Upstream (UFP) and Downstream (DFP) Facing Ports supporting 40Gbps bandwidth, the Acer ProDesigner PE320QX enables effortless daisy-chaining of secondary high-resolution displays and high-speed storage arrays, over a single USB-C® connection.

On September 7, 2026, Parade announced in cooperation with FIT – a leading cable manufacturer – the successful deployment of Parade Ultra Linear Redrivers (LRDs) in an OSFP (Octal Small Form Factor Pluggable) for inclusion on the June 2026 PF43s InfiniBand Trade Association Integrators List at both XDR (224Gbps) and NDR (112Gbps) data rates. Such lists ensure seamless operation with key AI servers, XPUs and switches. OEMs can now feel confident employing Parade LRDs in copper cable solutions from 2 to 4 meters to reducing power, latency and rack weight, as well as improved rack routing. Parade Ultra Ethernet series of linear redrivers are capable of supporting latest 802.3dj ethernet specification as well as InfiniBand, UALink, NVLink and OIF standards and extends our commitment to enabling the short reach, high-performance, AI scaleup market with low power, low latency solutions.

On October 5, 2026, Parade announced UGREEN has selected Parade’s chipset solution for its flagship USB4® Hub. Powered by Parade’s USB-IF certified PS9010 USB4® dock controller and PS5513 dual-port USB Power Delivery controller, the hub delivers certified multi-protocol high-speed connectivity, comprehensive peripheral expansion, and robust fast charging in a single, compact form factor. The new UGREEN USB4® Hub addresses the connectivity demands of modern workstations by equipping users with an all-in-one expansion interface. In addition to host pass-through charging, the hub provides a dedicated USB4® downstream port for daisy-chaining, multiple USB 3.2 10Gbps and 5Gbps ports, a 2.5GBase-T Ethernet port, dual SD and TF card readers, an HDMI display output, and an integrated audio headphone jack.

Parade Technologies, Ltd. is a leading supplier of mixed-signal ICs for a variety of popular display and high-speed interface standards used in computers, consumer electronics and display panels. The fabless semiconductor company was founded in 2005 and publicly listed on Taipei Exchange (“TPEx”) in 2011 (stock code: 4966). Parade’s portfolio of IC products serves the growing demand for HDMI™, DisplayPort™, SATA, and USB ICs for display, storage and interface applications.

In addition to being a technology innovator, Parade is an active participant and leader in industry standards-setting organizations. Parade Technologies, Inc., a wholly owned US-based subsidiary of Parade Technologies, Ltd., is a member of VESA (Video Electronics Standard Association). Parade Technologies, Inc. has made key contributions to the development of VESA’s DisplayPort™ digital video interface standard.

Parade leverages its close relationships with market leading Tier-1 OEMs to develop ICs that provide unique system capabilities. Many of the company’s devices integrate proprietary technologies that offer superior system signal integrity, advanced system integration and enhanced power efficiency. As a result of the company’s “standards-plus” design philosophy, Parade ICs have been designed into products offered by nearly every leading computer and display vendor worldwide.

The reader is advised that these consolidated financial statements have been prepared originally in NT$ and conformed with the adoption of IFRSs. In the event of any differences between NT$ and US$ version, the NT$ version shall prevail.
